title: utils: clean up tls-verify handling and warn about more ineffective options
body:
- The two adjacent "if opts.tlsVerify.Present()" blocks in imageOptions.newSystemContext did exactly the same check; merge them.

- The "FIXME FIXME" comment predates the warnIfUsed implementation; keep a single FIXME for the still-unimplemented "even if ignored" part.

- warnAboutIneffectiveOptions only knew about --dest-compress/--dest-decompress, so e.g. --dest-precompute-digests passed to a docker-daemon destination was silently ignored. Warn for --dest-precompute-digests (docker only) and --dest-oci-accept-uncompressed-layers (oci only), same style as the existing warnings.
